name: ToneMapping
doc: The display transform that compresses scene radiance into the screen's range.

variants.name: filmic
variants.doc: Filmic ACES-style curve with a soft toe and highlight desaturation, similar to Unreal's default; the most cinematic.

variants.name: neutral
variants.doc: Khronos PBR Neutral: keeps material colours accurate up to bright highlights.

variants.name: acesFit
variants.doc: Narkowicz's per-channel ACES fit (the legacy curve; saturated highlights).
